newsitem.title: INDIA: Piramal offers to buy G.P. Elec shares.
newsitem.headline: Piramal offers to buy G.P. Elec shares.

text.p: Piramal Enterprises said on Wednesday it was offering to buy shares of group firm G.P. Electronics Ltd at a price of 30 rupees a share, describing it as an exit route to shareholders.

"The offer is being made in response to requests from some of the G.P. Electronics shareholders who are currently not able to liquidate their holdings in view of the illiquid nature of the stock and the low ruling market price," it said.
The share was quoted at 23 rupees on the Bombay Stock Exchange on Wednesday, up from 19 rupees earlier this week.

"The promoters believe that the stock is significantly undervalued but in the present environment, the only option that could be made available to those shareholders who are desirous of liquidating their stocks at reasonable rates, is to provide them with the proposed exit route," a statement said.
It said shareholders who are willing to take a longer term view may find their investment in the company satisfactory.
The company plans to invest 120 million rupees to upgrade the plant and technology and to change product mix from commodity type ring magnets to speciality magnets, it said.
"The promoters already hold 51.3 percent of equity stock in the company, and the offer to buy the rest from whoever wants to sell is not being made to acquire management control," it said.
